display_name: Measured Cordoba early-Gothic facing ashlar core
intent: A source-bounded intact facing wythe built from complete stone volumes, Santa Marina/Naranjo material identity, proxy-bounded calcarenite body relief, and finite measured-envelope medieval face dressing before damage, ornament, wall-core inference, or unmeasured tooling depth.

source_policy.reference_method: Cordoba surveyed block dimensions, Historic Environment Scotland broken-bond guidance, Historic England fine flush-joint guidance, measured Caen-stone tool spacing, Moulis archaeological and experimental fine-layage dimensions and density, Santa Marina/Naranjo petrography, relative sunlit color-family measurements from the licensed Santa Marina facade photograph, and an explicitly labeled Sabucina calcarenite surface-metrology proxy for stone-body relief only

measurement_authority.construction_scope: single facing wythe; wall core is not inferred

physical_scale_m.face_relief_status: stone-body relief uses a measured comparable-calcarenite proxy; whole-face plane deformation remains zero
physical_scale_m.tool_mark_depth_status: unknown; no geometric or normal depth authored

coordinate_contract.topology_rule: New Boolean or fracture faces must receive an explicit fracture-interior value; do not infer cut-face identity from interpolated triangle data.

surface_scale_contract.tooling_anti_repetition_rule: Select one of three density channels per block, rotate by the explicit face angle, and offset by the explicit phase. Marks are finite 60-94 mm impacts rather than infinite procedural stripes.
surface_scale_contract.anti_repetition_rule: Use per-block phase, quarter-turn rotation, and mirror variation, then blend 64 mm and incommensurate 91 mm samples of the same body masks; never align one identical detail tile across the complete wall.
surface_scale_contract.reason: The four-metre construction field cannot resolve the paper's 1 mm thin-section evidence. Architecture and material-body structure therefore use separate sampling scales.

surface_relief_contract.proxy_scope: stone-body relief distribution only; comparable yellow coarse calcarenite rather than Santa Marina/Naranjo
surface_relief_contract.height_encoding: 16-bit normalized height with explicit metre range in the material manifest
surface_relief_contract.normal_generation: periodic central differences at the declared 64 mm physical span
surface_relief_contract.anti_repetition_rule: Use the same per-block phase, quarter-turn, mirror, and 64 mm/91 mm blend as the mineral identity masks; relief may not become a wall-aligned square tile.

visual_hierarchy_contract.macro_read: The four-metre construction field and twenty-step stone families establish block-to-block warm, pale, and cool grouping.
visual_hierarchy_contract.medium_read: Authored piecewise graphic planes change value inside each individual stone without claiming unmeasured geometric depth.
visual_hierarchy_contract.linework_read: Packed selective structural-ink and arris-highlight lanes are live optical color layers, not baked light or universal outlines.
visual_hierarchy_contract.micro_read: Measured-proxy body relief, fossil color, pore color, and finite tooling are fully visible only within 0.30 m and fade smoothly to zero by 3.5 m.
visual_hierarchy_contract.quiet_surface_rule: At normal gameplay distance, microdetail cannot compete with block silhouette, bond, joint rhythm, or medium graphic planes.
visual_hierarchy_contract.damage_rule: Fracture, erosion, edge loss, lichen, damp, soot, and repair remain disabled in this intact core.

intact_pbr_contract.base_color_rule: intrinsic stone color only; no photographed sunlight, shadow, cavity, or ambient occlusion
intact_pbr_contract.roughness_status: authored calibration under neutral and grazing light; no published optical roughness measurement
intact_pbr_contract.normal_and_height: stone-body relief uses the measured Sabucina calcarenite proxy; block planes, tool marks, arrises, mortar, and damage remain neutral until separately measured
intact_pbr_contract.ambient_occlusion_rule: no stone-body AO; only physically recessed geometry may contribute
intact_pbr_contract.stylization_rule: selective ink and arris-highlight lanes are live downstream optical color layers; they group values without changing measured body relief, metallic, AO, or material provenance

default_overlays.reason: The first acceptance pass must prove architectural stone without damage or narrative grime.

unreal_reconstruction.rule: Base material remains neutral and tiling. Reconstruct the per-block phase, quarter-turn, mirror, and 64 mm/91 mm body-mask and body-height blends exactly, using the manifest metre range for bump amplitude. Reproduce the 0.30 m full-detail and 3.5 m zero-detail hierarchy before parity is claimed. Fracture interiors, carved trims, traversal language, lichen, and damp are explicit geometry or overlay lanes rather than universal texture noise.
